subject.title: Session modelOverride persists across gateway restarts, silently overrides config default

question: Should explicit and legacy session model pins survive `/new` and gateway restart by default, and what official clear/reconcile surface should users get?
rationale: Current code intentionally preserves explicit and legacy pins, while the requested automatic clear or config-precedence change would alter persisted user choices and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Preserve pins, add opt-in recovery
options.body: Keep explicit pins durable by default, but add a dry-run `sessions model-reset` or reconcile/doctor path with scoped opt-in clearing and status warnings.

options.title: Clear explicit pins on reset
options.body: Make `/new` or `sessions.reset` drop explicit pins too, accepting a compatibility break for users who expect durable session model choices.

options.title: Document current behavior only
options.body: Leave runtime semantics as-is and rely on `/model default`, status messaging, and docs without adding a bulk recovery surface.

recommendation.title: Preserve pins, add opt-in recovery
recommendation.body: Keep explicit pins durable by default, but add a dry-run `sessions model-reset` or reconcile/doctor path with scoped opt-in clearing and status warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest traced history across shared model resolution, docs, and current session-pin behavior, so he is the best available owner for the product semantics choice.
